name: jaspersoft-tools
description: Jaspersoft automation for Claude Code: the jasper-deploy skill for designing, compiling, and deploying JasperReports Server artifacts, with a 4.7-10.1 version/upgrade reference library.

plugins.name: jasper-deploy
plugins.description: Design, compile, and deploy JasperReports artifacts to JasperReports Server over REST v2: JR7 jrxml scaffolding from SQL, lint gate, dashboards via export-inject-import, datasources, Domains, OLAP, themes, scheduling, permissions, STAGE/PROD promotion, and doc-derived references covering JRS 4.7 through 10.1 including the upgrade/migration playbook. Requires PowerShell 5.1 or pwsh 7+, JDK 11+, psql, curl, Python 3, and a JasperReports 7.0.6 jar directory (see the skill's jrs.config.example.json).
